notes: The native inventory above is partial, not an SBOM or a distribution approval.
Base images are digest-pinned, but Debian apt dependencies are not individually pinned. Do not infer future rebuilt image identity from this test.
The worker currently performs OCR on page renders then overlays a text-only PDF onto the source; visible scan preservation has one synthetic-case verification, not broad PDF/scan coverage.
No editor OCR action, production job orchestration or native Windows OCR integration has been completed.
Registry metadata and upstream documentation were inspected; no packages were installed or adopted.

The core maintainer identifies permissive compiled third-party libraries and asks that required attributions be included. An open issue is not proof that every current npm artifact lacks notices; the exact artifact still requires inspection.

A possible local-only route would use approved PDF.js rendering, reviewed OCR WASM/model assets and approved PDF composition. It requires a new dependency/architecture review and pixel/semantic/privacy/cancellation tests, not merely enabling a flag.
All worker/core/model paths must be local or self-hosted; default CDN downloads are not an approved configuration. Scans must remain visually unchanged.
